title: Why Some Roots Get Fat Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A fat carrot, a banyan tree with ropes hanging from its branches and a maize plant on little legs are all roots. Diya asks: if a root drinks water, why do some roots get fat and some hang from branches?

You will see the three root systems (tap, fibrous, adventitious), zoom into the four regions of the root tip and follow one cell on its journey, then the root modifications for storing food, support and breathing: carrot, turnip, sweet potato, prop roots, stilt roots and pneumatophores. Then prop vs stilt roots, a pause and think check, a worked example, the exam trap, an original NEET statement question and a recap card.

This is Episode 40 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 A carrot, a banyan and a maize plant
0:35 Tap, fibrous and adventitious roots
1:17 Zoom in: the four regions of the root tip
2:06 Roots with new jobs
3:01 Prop roots vs stilt roots + pause and think
3:45 Worked example: name each root
4:10 Exam trap: sweet potato vs potato
4:32 Practice question (NEET pattern)
5:01 Recap and three questions

Next episode: The Stem and its Modifications. A potato with eyes: why is it a stem?
